chats.answer:
For an RV, my top LiFePO4 (lithium iron phosphate) battery brands are Battle Born, Epoch, LiTime, and SOK.

The best choice depends on whether you want maximum reliability, the best value, or enough capacity to run appliances while boondocking.

For most RV owners, I'd recommend a 12V 200Ah LiFePO4 battery with a low-temperature charging cutoff, built-in battery management system (BMS), and Bluetooth monitoring.

A 200Ah battery provides approximately 2.56 kWh of energy, roughly twice the usable capacity of a typical 100Ah lead-acid battery bank.
